remarks: Spacious and well-maintained rental offering 8 rooms, 5 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and a finished lower-level family room, providing plenty of living space for today's lifestyle. Remodeled in 2019 and freshly painted, this home is move-in ready and features laundry hook-ups on the lower level for added convenience. Enjoy a private shared backyard, perfect for outdoor relaxation, along with three tandem off-street parking spaces. Conveniently located near shopping, restaurants, schools, parks, and major commuting routes.  No pets. No smoking in the building. All forms of assisted financing programs are welcome. Available for immediate occupancy.
